d.d: All living beings; the essence or soul of such beings.

d.x: Don’t try to jive me! I know where you were last night!

d.d: To dance, originally to jive or swing music; later, to jazz, rock and roll, rhythm and blues, disco, etc.
To speak in jive (jazz or hipster slang).
A dance style popular in the 1940–50s.
Swing, a style of jazz music.
A slang associated with jazz musicians; hepcat patois or hipster jargon.
